# External dataset: UCI Wine

**File:** `uci_wine.csv`

This is the Wine recognition dataset distributed with scikit-learn and originally
derived from the UCI Machine Learning Repository. It contains chemical analyses
of wines grown in the same region of Italy but originating from three cultivars.

## Why it is useful in this course

The dataset is small enough for classroom work but rich enough to illustrate:

- exploratory data analysis;
- standardization;
- multiclass classification;
- k-nearest neighbours;
- decision trees and random forests;
- support-vector machines;
- principal component analysis;
- clustering;
- model comparison and cross-validation.

## Structure

- 178 observations
- 13 continuous input features
- `target`: numerical class (0, 1, 2)
- `class_name`: human-readable class label
